_about: Criteria of tests/vet_clean/run_tests.py. Reference values measured 2026-11-23 with commit 512cf768a (branch m1-clean-release), CPU, GCC 13, -ffp-contract=off, MPCDF Raven. max / min: bounds; equal: exact values; near: [reference, relative tolerance] (lists: the last element, i.e. the finest level); last: true applies max / min to the last element of a list only.

conservation_lz._about: the L_z-exact caps / cuts all on (+ floorcap_lz on every cell): drifts as conservation_sp, dLz_gr without the ledger; restart and forced dt_retry bitwise; cs_dLz_gr is reported only (the cell-centred flux vector, as conservation_cs)

floorcap_spin._about: floorcap_lz_spin (floor cells thinner than the IC density, the whole velocity capped, its L_z the rest's rigid rotation): drifts as conservation_lz incl. sp dLz_gr without the ledger; n_v capped cells > 0; restart, forced dt_retry, 1 vs 1 x 2 MeshBlocks (tile) bitwise; nospin_sp_dLz_gr reported only

momentum_box._about: a report: dP_max / dP_cyc are recorded, not bounded; the test passes when the run completes with finite dP and no CLEAN WARNING

radwave._about: per case (thin, mid, one, trapped, mid_phase, one_phase): |c_ph/c_ph,exact - 1|, |d(damping)|/omega and the damping per radian (> 0: no growth); dt_gain: dt with / without hydro/rad_signal_speed_diff at x = 0.01; dt_gain_phase: dt with / without hydro/rad_signal_speed_phase at x = 0.1 (2.15) and x = 1 (1: the weights agree there)

wedge_sym._about: fphi = |sum F_phi| / sum |F_r| on the 20 deg (exact), 3.7 and 7.3 deg (vet_gd_wall_sym) wedges; fth = |sum F_theta| / sum |F_r| on the theta-periodic 20 deg shell with vet_gd_theta_seam_sym (1.6e-14 at cycle 8; 1.1e-5 before the seam image of the theta-periodic ghost rows, CleanSeamImage); wedge_fatal / theta_fatal = 1: the narrow wedge without vet_gd_wall_sym, and the theta-periodic shell without vet_gd_theta_seam_sym, stop with the FATAL; fth_rot = the same on the 30 deg theta-periodic wedge with GL 11 x 12 turning about z (EMA ring, cross-fade); rot_fatal = 1: GL 10 x 12 staggered (no equatorial mirror) stops with the mirror FATAL

floor_pay._about: dE from t = 0 (the initial floor energy is paid before the t = 0 output; dE0, the t = 0 -> 1 step, is reported); ekin_*: hydro/floor_from_ekin with vceil 1.2e-2 (energy, mass, L_z as conservation_sp); worst_*: the same run with hydro/floor_audit_worst prints and stays bitwise

ceiling_metric._about: floor_from_ekin + vceil 0.5 vs no ceiling at t = 0, cell by cell (cs: metric |v| of the contravariant v^a): v_phi kept, |V| = max(vceil, |v_phi|) where capped, theta part 0, the rest scaled in [0, 1]

inf_reject._about: rad_vet/clean_dbg_inf = 4: one non-finite E iterate in cycle 4's first stage-1 write-back; implicit_pos_floor must not floor or book it, the stage is rejected and redone

merge_lat._about: merged lateral cells, merge_lat_mom = radial: drifts of the closed noisy shells, change of each group's M, E, sum V m_r, L per average, radial flow without lateral velocity, restart / dt_retry / layout bitwise; rigid_dLz: the old operator on the same decks must drift (dropped group rotations)

floor_dt._about: hydro/dt_floor_courant = 0.6 on the shell with floor gas: energy as conservation_sp, restart and forced dt_retry bitwise; dt_gain (mean dt with / without the key) reported

star_smoke._about: largest |x - x_ref| / max|x_ref| of the history columns STAR_COLS over 20 cycles against ref/star_smoke.user.hst / .hydro.hst (CPU, recorded with ffc77d4d3, star_vet binary md5 53f436d9, star_small.athinput of the same commit, merge_lat_mom = radial; the reference before, 1e84c765d, was of the rigid merge, max deviation 0.189 in 2-KE). The run is bitwise identical on 1, 4 and 16 OpenMP threads (0 difference). Bound 2e-4: changes at the solver tolerance (clean_pc_sweep = rb, implicit clean_conv_max doubled, MeshBlock splits at tile 4) move these columns by at most 5.1e-5 (measured on 4a26282a6); a physical change moves the history: merge_lat_mom = rigid 0.21, time2_gtime_slope = false 5.3e-3 (clean_face_hctau = false 1.7e-3, cfl_number 0.29 instead of 0.3 3.9e-2: on 1e84c765d)

wb_star._about: a report, not a criterion (as momentum_box): the velocities of the unseeded BSG column after 20 cycles in the stars' well-balance mode; not bounded. Measured 4a26282a6: v_in 3.1e-3, v_all 0.68 (photosphere and floor gas), lat_mid 1.4e-11; the static envelope of wb_sp / wb_cs (1e-8) has no counterpart here, see README

idort_beams._about: L1 = sum |E - E_exact| / sum E_exact over the box; the exact field is the cell average of the straight beams at the angles the code snapped them to. lum_top = energy of the third row below x1max / exact. The beams are 4 cells wide and stay straight (full width at half maximum 0.8 cells above the exact), but carry 1.19 x the exact energy (the cap of the streaming share at the beam edges; before the ray-hole fix of the thin share 1.79, 1.39, 1.20, 1.09 x at 1, 2, 4, 8 cells), which dominates L1: regression references, not accuracy bounds. The energy flux is exact: flux_err = largest |sum of vet_phi1 over a row / injected flux - 1| (6e-8)
idort_beams._ref: Ma et al. 2025 (IDORT) sec. 4.1.1; Jiang 2021, ApJS 253, 49 sec. 4.2

idort_beams_mb._about: largest |difference| of the dumps: 4 MeshBlocks along x2 in tile mode (layout_tile 16) vs 1 MeshBlock, and 4 along x1 in block mode vs 1

idort_shadow._about: L1 of E against the exact attenuated beams (the thermal part, a T^4 <= 1 against E_b = 200 per beam, is not in the exact field)
idort_shadow._ref: Ma et al. 2025 (IDORT) sec. 4.1.4; Jiang 2021, ApJS 253, 49 sec. 4.3; Jiang, Stone & Davis 2012, ApJS 199, 14, sec. 6.5

idort_shadow_gl._about: as idort_shadow, the general 8 x 32 ray set; the exact field uses the snapped beam angle (11.38 deg)

idort_cylinder._about: L1 along y = 0 of E inside (x < 1) and outside (x > 1.05), and outside of the energy flux Phi_x / c (vet_phi1, F_out; what the paper measures) and of the face momentum F_x / c (vet_f1, FH_out), against the exact transport solution ref/idort_cylinder_exact.npz. FH_out is about 0.2, a regression reference (a study of 11-21 with other keys attributed it to the harmonic face opacity at the cylinder edge; not re-measured)
idort_cylinder._ref: Ma et al. 2025 (IDORT) sec. 4.1.2; Jiang 2021, ApJS 253, 49 sec. 4.6

idort_radshock_m2._about: L1 = mean |q - q_ref| / mean |q_ref| of rho, v, T_gas, T_rad at t = 2e-10 s against the semi-analytic profile ref/idort_radshock_m2.txt (no shift), with the production tableau time2_tableau = sdirk2 and its default time2_gtime_slope; hesdirk2 (the v20.3 bench) gives 3.56 / 2.13 / 3.85 / 2.59e-4

idort_radshock_m5._about: L1 = mean |q - q_ref| / mean |q_ref| of rho, v, T_gas, T_rad at t = 2e-10 s against the semi-analytic profile ref/idort_radshock_m5.txt (no shift), with the production tableau time2_tableau = sdirk2 and its default time2_gtime_slope; hesdirk2 (the v20.3 bench) gives 1.69 / 0.817 / 1.62 / 0.941e-3

idort_thermal_eq2._about: max |T/T_exact - 1| over the dumps (the first dump, after 5 steps of dt = 5e-4, 5 to 1e5 relaxation times each, dominates) and the total-energy drift

diffusion._about: Gaussian pulse in a static pure scatterer (the asymptotic-preserving diffusion limit, e.g. Jiang et al. 2012 ApJS 199 14): errD = variance growth / (2 D t) - 1 at tau_cell = 10, 1e3, 1e5 (bounded, the diffusion limit is exact as tau_cell -> inf); L1 vs the exact Gaussian of the diffusion equation (the 128-cell spatial error); errD_2d, L1_2d: the isotropic 2-D pulse (64^2, tau_cell 1e3); th_min, th_max: the top-hat at tau_cell = 1e4 minus background, minus amplitude (maximum principle: >= 0, <= 0); tau_cell = 1 (errD_tau1, L1_tau1: transport, not diffusion) is reported, not bounded

radshock._about: Lowrie & Edwards 2008 Shock Waves 18 129, Mach 2 subcritical, 256 cells, against the semi-analytic profile ref/idort_radshock_m2.txt (grey non-equilibrium DIFFUSION, P = E/3) with the PRODUCTION closure (idort_radshock_m2 runs the same shock with clean_closure = eddington): L1 = mean |q - q_ref| / mean |q_ref|. Most of the ~1 % in T_rad is the closure (2.5e-4 with eddington); the bounds are about 2 x the measured values, the near values pin the accuracy

marshak._about: non-equilibrium Marshak wave with constant c_v (not Su & Olson 1997, whose c_v ~ T^3 the ideal EOS cannot represent): no analytic solution, so a robustness criterion (E, T_gas > 0; Emax = max E / E_b and Tmax = max T / T_b <= 1, the maximum principle; Erise = largest increase of E into the slab / E_b, round-off) plus the front x_f (T_gas = T_b / 2 at t = 200) as a regression value

advect_uniform._about: uniform medium at v = 0.01 c at the fixed point of the coupling (He, Wibking & Krumholz 2024 MNRAS 531 1228, arXiv:2404.08247, sec. 5.5; the IC solves it with the M1 chi(f), the scheme's VET closure differs at O(beta^2)): dT, dE = largest relative change over the run

advect_pulse._about: advecting radiation pulse (Krumholz, Klein, McKee & Bolstad 2007 ApJ 667 626; Jiang 2021 sec. 4.4): L1 of the moving pulse shifted back by v t against the pulse at rest, per dump (Galilean invariance of the comoving diffusion); near: the last dump

shadow._about: shadow test (Hayes & Norman 2003 ApJS 147 197; Jiang et al. 2012 ApJS 199 14): umbra = sum E / sum E_noclump over the geometric umbra behind the clump (cells outside it, D >= 1.5, every sight line of which to the illuminated face crosses the clump core D < 1); lit_err = max |E / E_noclump - 1| where no sight line comes near the clump
